items.work: Piano pieces and accompaniments, recorded by the composer
items.performers: Camille Saint-Saëns, piano; with Meyriane Héglon and Gabriel Willaume
items.label: Marston Records
items.note: Saint-Saëns at the keyboard: the 1904 Gramophone and Typewriter sides include extracts from the Second Piano Concerto, the Rhapsodie d’Auvergne and an improvised cadenza on Africa, with his 1919 remakes of the Valse mignonne. The set also holds the sides on which he accompanies Héglon in arias from Ascanio and Samson et Dalila.

items.note: All five concertos in one set, including the Egyptian with its Nubian love song. Phillip Borg-Wheeler’s booklet note is free to read on the label’s page.
